name: What kind of permits are needed for prefab ADU site preparation?

mainEntity.name: What kind of permits are needed for prefab ADU site preparation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permits for prefab ADU site preparation typically include grading permits, building permits for the foundation, and utility permits for connections like sewer, water, and electricity. The specific permits required can vary by jurisdiction within our service area, such as in Alameda or Pleasanton. Hometelligent Inc. assists clients in identifying and securing the necessary permits, streamlining the approval process before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits for prefab ADU site preparation include grading, foundation, and utility permits, varying by local jurisdiction.
